card.name: Final zero in two-digit numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 or 8 that completes a two- or three-digit number, such as 1:30, 4:30, 120, 140 or 80. It appears in roof ventilation ratios, clock times, temperatures and measurements in general web text.

modes.label: Ratios and sizes
modes.description: The last digit of a ventilation ratio or a dimension in roofing and building text.
modes.example: A Galvalume 5-vee unfinished metal roof with a 1:3<<0>>0 vented attic

modes.label: Clock times
modes.description: The 0 in half-hour times such as 4:30 or 5:30.
modes.example: Time: 10 AM-4:3<<0>> PM Hot Tamales, anyone

modes.label: Temperatures and amounts
modes.description: The last digit of a rounded temperature or yearly amount.
modes.example: the water heater thermostat is set to around 14<<0>> degrees Fahrenheit
